description: Use when the user wants a cheaper way to do a job and names a feature or kind of tool rather than one product: 'cheaper keyword research', 'forms without Typeform', 'what can replace our CRM'. Filter by the vendor they pay for, a feature, a category or a path type (switch, cheaper plan, open source, pay per use, agent skill, build it). Returns compact recipe cards, each with its best priced path that saves money; get_recipe has every path, cost and source. For one product they pay for, find_alternatives re-costs it at their own price and usage. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses): don't send personal data or secrets.

category.description: Category name from list_categories, e.g. 'CRM', 'SEO data'

feature.description: A feature they rely on, e.g. 'rank tracking', 'e-signatures'

path_type.description: Only recipes offering this kind of replacement

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'client approval portal' or 'semrush backlinks'

vendor.description: Product currently paid for, e.g. 'Airtable', 'Salesforce', 'Semrush Pro'

name: search_recipes
title: Search replacement recipes
